## Summary

Describe what changed and why it helps learners.

## Type

- [ ] Content correction
- [ ] New lesson/content
- [ ] UI or accessibility improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation

## Language Review

If this changes Nepali content, note your basis for the change:

- [ ] Native/fluent speaker review
- [ ] Learner correction
- [ ] Source-backed correction
- [ ] Needs maintainer review

## Checks

- [ ] I ran `npm run build`
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint`
- [ ] I checked the changed page on mobile or a narrow viewport
